At AWE, I was able to get in touch with the team building the **Raven Prism,** which are upcoming smart glasses with **a strong focus on privacy and openness** . Let me tell you more about this very interesting project!

...

## Raven Resonance
Its first product is **Raven Prism** , which the company doesn’t even call smartglasses but **“the first ambient computer in the form of glasses”** . The name “ambient computer” is surely a marketing term, but it is interesting because it makes you immediately understand the vision of these glasses.

...

## Raven Prism
Raven Resonance’s first product is **Raven Prism, which are display smartglasses that let you run dedicated applications.** At first look, they are not much different from the many other smartglasses on the market, but actually there are a few key differences to talk about.

...

...

The price and release date of Raven Prism are still undisclosed. **But the glasses should be launched before the end of the year.**
